title: [GMCP 203.040.02] Production path: OpenTelemetry, metrics, logs, traces, and diagnostics
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-040-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP emits bounded OpenTelemetry-compatible traces, metrics and structured logs across host, gateway, transport, server and callback boundaries, propagating standard trace context from MCP metadata. RED/USE, queue, cache, policy, consent, task and lifecycle signals have stable schemas and cardinality budgets; payload redaction is structural; diagnostics explain failures locally and export only under explicit policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
